description: Culture-aware decimal input. Accepts both comma and dot as the decimal separator, cleans pasted text (currency symbols, units, thousands separators), formats the value on blur for the chosen culture, rounds to DecimalPlaces, supports Min/Max/Step with +/- steppers and ArrowUp/ArrowDown keys, offers a percent mode (the model keeps the fraction while the field shows the percentage), and reports DataAnnotations validation messages when used inside an EditForm.

parameters.name: Value
parameters.description: Current decimal value. null when the input is empty or holds unparsable text.

parameters.name: ValueChanged
parameters.description: Fires when the committed value changes (on change/blur, not on every keystroke).

parameters.name: ValueExpression
parameters.description: Expression identifying the bound model field. Blazor supplies it automatically when you use @bind-Value; it is what links the input to DataAnnotationsValidator messages inside an EditForm.

parameters.name: DecimalPlaces
parameters.description: Number of fractional digits used for display and for rounding the committed value (clamped to 0-28).

parameters.name: UseGrouping
parameters.description: Show thousands separators while the field is not being edited (default true).

parameters.name: Culture
parameters.description: Culture used for parsing and formatting. Defaults to CultureInfo.CurrentCulture.

parameters.name: Min
parameters.description: Smallest allowed value, on the displayed scale (in percent mode, Min="0" ... Max="100" means 0-100 %).

parameters.name: Max
parameters.description: Largest allowed value, on the displayed scale (in percent mode, Min="0" ... Max="100" means 0-100 %).

parameters.name: Step
parameters.description: Amount added or removed by the steppers and the arrow keys, on the displayed scale (default 1 — in percent mode, one percentage point).

parameters.name: ShowButtons
parameters.description: Show the +/- stepper buttons.

parameters.name: Percent
parameters.description: Percent mode: Value holds the fraction (0.15) while the input shows and accepts the percentage (15). Min, Max and Step also work on the percentage scale, and a "%" suffix is added unless Suffix says otherwise.

parameters.name: Label
parameters.description: Field label.

parameters.name: Placeholder
parameters.description: Placeholder text shown while the input is empty.

parameters.name: Prefix
parameters.description: Prefix text rendered before the input (e.g. "EUR").

parameters.name: Suffix
parameters.description: Suffix text rendered after the input (e.g. "/ pc").

parameters.name: Error
parameters.description: Error message. When set, it wins over any validation message coming from the surrounding EditContext, replaces the help text and marks the field invalid.

parameters.name: HelpText
parameters.description: Help text rendered below the input.

parameters.name: Disabled
parameters.description: Disable the input.

parameters.name: ReadOnly
parameters.description: Render the input as read-only.

parameters.name: Required
parameters.description: Marks the input as required. Shows a required marker on the label and sets aria-required on the input element.

parameters.name: AutoComplete
parameters.description: HTML autocomplete attribute. Common values: "on", "off".

parameters.name: Id
parameters.description: Explicit id of the input element. When omitted, a unique id is generated so the label stays associated.

parameters.name: Class
parameters.description: Additional CSS class(es) applied to the wrapper.

examples.title: Czech formatting with a currency prefix
Percent mode (model keeps the fraction)
examples.code:
<TmDecimalInput @bind-Value="vatRate" Label="VAT rate" Percent="true" Min="0" Max="100" Step="1" />
@* vatRate = 0.21m is shown as 21,00 % *@
